# Enterprise Developer API Policies

## 1. Overview
Connects Day 49 Developer Platform with Day 51 Enterprise Administration. Sets boundaries on internal and partner developers building against the FitCore API.

## 2. Policy Enforcements
* `maxTokensPerApplication`: Limits total active OAuth tokens generated by custom applications.
* `rateLimitTier`: Assigns enterprise rate-limiting brackets (e.g. 5,000 requests/minute).
* `allowCustomWebhooks`: Controls custom webhook subscription creation.
* `requiredIpWhitelisting`: Mandates static IP ingress for API access touching sensitive financial ledgers.
